market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela crude production was 1.021m bpd in Feb 2026, ~1.095m in Mar 2026; April exports 1.23m bpd is a 7-yr high. With production already very near 1.1m and trending up post-sanctions waivers, hitting 1.2m in any 2026 month is plausible to likely. Market 0.505 close to fair.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether 'production' (secondary sources figure) tracks the higher export figure or lags.
